notes: Account profile: mid-to-large hospital chain + clinical research arm (EHR, imaging reports, pathology PDFs). Heavy PHI; strict access controls.
Primary ask: replace legacy keyword search with vector-retrieval + reranker to support clinical decision support and codified QA for clinicians.
Scale: initial POC targets 2M documents (notes + reports) growing to 18-25M in 6-12 months. Peak indexing window must support 10-20TB of fresh data ingestion.
Latency/throughput requirements: retrieval p50 < 60ms for embedding lookup, end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) p95 < 350ms for clinician workflows; offline batch queries allowed overnight for analytics.
Throughput: expect up to 300 qps in peak clinical hours across 4 regions (NA primary, EU for research), burst to 500 qps tolerated for 15m windows.

Cost sensitivity: high — CFO wants unit economics modeled (cost/query, cost/day) before moving to Dedicated. Open to Optimize pricing recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce per-query cost.

Model preferences: prefer open/quantized embedding models (smaller footprint for production) and a two-stage approach: dense retrieval (faiss/pinecone-like) -> transformer reranker for top-K. Interested in Redwood's model catalog and verified performance profiles.
Routing/fallback: must support mandatory VPC routing for PHI; fallback to lower-cost model variants when dedicated pool saturated; automatic fallback must preserve audit logging.

Security/compliance: HIPAA/BAA mandatory; SSO via SAML + role-based access for indexing/refresh; detailed immutable audit logs with per-token masking and retention controls; customer-managed KMS/HSM preferred; log export to Splunk/CloudWatch.
POC success metrics: Recall@10 > 0.80 for clinical queries, MRR improvement over baseline by 25%, reranking latency p95 < 200ms, end-to-end clinician satisfaction score >= 4/5.
Quoted ask from CTO: 'We need deterministic costs and an architecture that scales without exposing PHI to third-party services.'

Current thought: propose Dedicated with private control plane (Redwood Private) + Optimize recommendations for quantization + KV cache to meet cost targets. Legal wants BAA and SOC2 evidence before infra access.
use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG for clinical documentation: vector embeddings for large-scale EHR and reports index + transformer-based reranking for high-precision retrieval. Focus on low-latency interactive queries for clinicians, strict PHI controls, and predictable unit economics.
poc_plan: 8-week pilot: Week 1-2 ingest 2M docs + schema mapping; Week 3-4 build embeddings + retrieval index; Week 5 integrate reranker + UI; Week 6-7 load test (300 qps) + cost evaluation; Week 8 evaluation & metrics review. Deliverable: decision doc and recommended Dedicated sizing.
technical_requirements: VPC-only dataplane, customer-managed KMS, audit log export, SAML SSO, support for multi-region index shards, TTL/retention controls, ability to pin model versions and automatic fallback policies.
commercial_notes: Customer prefers 12-month committed Dedicated contract if POC hits SLOs. Looking for pricing for pilot first (trial credits), then committed pool pricing. Ask finance for modeled cost per query at 300 qps with 20M index and reranker usage 10%.
recent_feedback: On 2024-09-12 POC kickoff call: 'If you can show a 2x improvement in MRR and keep per-query cost under target, procurement will fast-track.'
risks: Legal delay on BAA; unknowns around indexing time for older scanned PDFs (OCR quality); reranker model latency variance under long clinical queries; multi-region data residency setup complexity.
